summary: Redid last night's blocked breakdowns fix (a failed YouTube query no longer blanks a dashboard tab), fixed a crash in the directed-beat script check, and wrote 7 video verdicts.
why: Main was green. The 13 Nov branch was blocked by the guard's no-network rule for renderer/, which renderer/thumbs.py already breaks on main; the fix was redone without touching it and the owner was asked to decide. The data audit was 22 h old (today's run not started), so the YouTube comparison was skipped.

findings.title: Data audit late, not failed
findings.detail: metrics/data-audit.json from 13 Nov 16:34 UTC; it had 2 behind_youtube errors for the 12 Nov Shorts.

findings.title: renderer/thumbs.py uses the network
findings.detail: YouTube search scraping and thumbnail downloads inside renderer/, against CLAUDE.md; it blocked last night's auditor branch. Owner notified.

findings.title: Name-and-figure hooks kept more viewers
findings.detail: Bezos Short 51.4% stayed; the 'You think X?' hooks lost 22-30 points on the hook line.

changes.title: Breakdowns survive a failed query
changes.detail: stats-deep replaces only the breakdown kinds it fetched (wrk-012).

changes.title: Directed-beat check no longer crashes
changes.detail: A moment's list or missing 'at' gives the rule, not a TypeError (ren-006).

changes.title: Analysis for 10-12 Nov Shorts
changes.detail: Verdicts for seven Shorts: 4 hits, 2 okay, 1 miss.
